# seerr_sonarr_language_profiles (Data Source)

Fetch Sonarr language profiles via /api/v3/languageprofile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_sonarr_language_profiles" "example" {
  api_key = "your-sonarr-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Sonarr API key.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base path when Sonarr is served under a subpath.
- `hostname` (String) Sonarr hostname when url is not provided.
- `port` (Number) Sonarr port when url is not provided.
- `url` (String) Full Sonarr URL. If set, it takes precedence over hostname, port, use_ssl, and base_url.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Use HTTPS when url is not provided.

### Read-Only

- `language_profiles` (Attributes List) List of language profiles from Sonarr. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--language_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--language_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `language_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Language profile ID.
- `name` (String) Language profile name.
